When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r }
# Generate a random sample of size 1000 (R code)
n <- 1000
U <- runif(n)

#4. Compare generated sample with target distribution
# Method 1: Histogram + True Density Curve

X <- ifelse(U < 0.5,
            log(2 * U),
            -log(2 * (1 - U)))

hist(X, probability = TRUE, breaks = 40,
     main = "Laplace(0,1): Generated Sample vs True Density",
     xlab = "x", col = "lightgray")

curve(0.5 * exp(-abs(x)),
      from = min(X), to = max(X),
      add = TRUE, col = "red", lwd = 2)

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}

# Method 3: Kolmogorov–Smirnov Test (Optional)

n <- 1000
U <- runif(n)

X <- ifelse(U < 0.5,
            log(2 * U),
            -log(2 * (1 - U)))

laplace_cdf <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x < 0,
         0.5 * exp(x),
         1 - 0.5 * exp(-x))
}

ks.test(X, laplace_cdf)
```


```{r}

# Method 2: Q–Q Plot (Empirical vs Theoretical)

p <- ppoints(n)

laplace_quantile <- ifelse(p < 0.5,
                           log(2 * p),
                           -log(2 * (1 - p)))

qqplot(laplace_quantile, X,
       main = "Q–Q Plot: Laplace Distribution",
       xlab = "Theoretical Quantiles",
       ylab = "Sample Quantiles")

abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)

```


```{r}

set.seed(123)

n <- 1000
U <- runif(n)

X_inv <- ifelse(U <= 0.1, 0,
         ifelse(U <= 0.3, 1,
         ifelse(U <= 0.5, 2,
         ifelse(U <= 0.7, 3, 4))))


empirical_inv <- table(X_inv) / n
theoretical <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3)

comparison_inv <- data.frame(
  x = 0:4,
  Theoretical = theoretical,
  Empirical = as.numeric(empirical_inv)
)

comparison_inv

```


```{r}
n <- 20 
u <- runif(n)
x <- 0

for (i in 1:n) {
  if (u[i] <= 0.1) {
    x[i] <- 0
  } else if (u[i] <= 0.3) {
    x[i] <- 1
  } else if (u[i] <= 0.5) {
    x[i] <- 2
  } else if (u[i] <= 0.7) {
    x[i] <- 3
  } else {
    x[i] <- 4
  }
}
X

# probability Bernouilli distribution with 
# the probability of success p=0.4
round(table(x)/n,1)
```


```{r}
rExp2 <- function(n, lambda, eta) {
U <- runif(n) # Uniform(0,1)
X <- eta - (1 / lambda) * log(U) # Inverse transform
return(X)
}
set.seed(123)
n <- 100
lambda <- 2
eta <- 3
sample_exp <- rExp2(n, lambda, eta)
sample_exp
```


```{r}
p <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
sample_q <- quantile(sample_exp, probs = p)
sample_q

p <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
theoretical_q <- eta - (1 / lambda) * log(1 - p)
theoretical_q

```


```{r}
comparison <- data.frame(
Probability = p,
Theoretical = theoretical_q,
Sample = sample_q
)
comparison
```
